Blushing bride Alina Habba stuns in THREE glittering wedding dresses as star-studded MAGA guests watch her marry Turkish billionaire

Alina Habba, 42, stunned in her lavish wedding looks as she married Turkish billionaire Turhan Mildon at the Waldorf Astoria in New York City.

Actual Article Body:
By EMMA JAMES, US SENIOR REPORTER and SHAWN COHEN, US SENIOR REPORTER and LAUREN ACTON-TAYLOR, US NEWS REPORTER

Published:  00:43 AEST, 28 September 2026   |  Updated:  02:11 AEST, 28 September 2026

634

View  comments

Alina Habba dazzled in three different wedding dresses when she married Turkish businessman Turhan Mildon in a glittering Waldorf Astoria wedding on Saturday – just eight months after her second divorce.

The New Jersey native, 42, said ‘I do’ to Mildon, 29, at the lavish celebration at the newly renovated New York hotel, where around 300 guests, including close family and MAGA royalty, gathered for a weekend of cocktails, caviar and couture-level glamour.

Habba walked hand-in-hand with her new husband in her gorgeous wedding dress - detailed with lace and a sweetheart neckline - at the ceremony on Saturday night.

She beamed as she walked down the mirrored aisle with her star-studded guests watching on, including Kash Patel, Todd Blanche, and Trump's advisor Margo Martin.

The blushing bride changed into her second gown of the evening, a showstopping sequined number, before walking out into the reception with her new husband.

The Mildons' first dance was to the song Hier Encore, with the ballad, originally recorded by Charles Aznavour, performed by a singer flown in from France.

The extravagant dinner reception was accompanied by an opulent 30-piece band and each guest was greeted with individual tins of caviar, the insider said.

The newlyweds celebrated at their luxe afterparty - with Habba wearing a short, glittery strapless number with white flowers decorating the skirt. Her looks were designed by Christina Martinelli, an insider told the Daily Mail.

And Grammy Award winner Nelly made a surprise entrance and were introduced to the stage by Habba's children during the afterparty around midnight.

Alina Habba, 42, said ‘I do’ to Turkish businessman Turhan Mildon, 29, in an intimate but lavish celebration at the newly renovated Waldorf hotel in Astoria, New York, with close family and friends gathered for a weekend of cocktails, caviar and couture-level glamour

The couple's first dance was to the song Heir Encore, with the ballad, originally recorded by Charles Aznavour, performed by a singer flown in from France

The newly wed was seen celebrating at their after party later in a short, glittery strapless number with white flowers decorating the skirt. Her looks were designed by Christina Martinelli, an insider told the Daily Mail

Pictures showed the venue adorned with flowers, while a beaming Habba held a bouquet of white lilies in her hand. Mildon was seen polished with a trimmed moustache, slicked hair and a bowtie.

The insider said that the couple's nuptials took over the entire fourth floor of the hotel and covered it with around 900,000 fresh blooms sourced from local farms and all over the world.

According to the source, the ceremony was themed as 'ethereal' with a blush and white palette while their cocktail took on a black and white, with dinner themed with rich golds, black and crimson.

Their afterparty, Club Mildon, was described as a seductive dark environment with leopard and hand woven tapestries echoing artistry from his native Middle East.

The pair had visited the venue numerous times leading up to their big day for tastings, menu curation, and intensive floral and decor prototype meetings with their exclusive planning team YSD Events.

Habba and Mildon exchanged vows in the Jade Room, where white cherry blossoms lined a mirrored aisle and stretched overhead beneath the room's soaring ceilings and chandelier.

Guests then passed through the historic Silver Corridor, which was transformed with deep red roses, floral arches and candles.
